business_problem: Forex Forest provides training in automated trading and develops software for executing trades through algorithmic models. To drive growth, the company wanted to migrate from its on-premises infrastructure to a scalable cloud platform that could support global expansion.
solution_summary: Forex Forest provides training in automated trading and develops software for executing trades through algorithmic models. To drive growth, the company wanted to migrate from its on-premises infrastructure to a scalable cloud platform that could support global expansion. Forex Forest chose to migrate its on-premises infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (AWS). Kwok says, “AWS offered services to develop our capabilities, a global infrastructure to drive expansion, and support to ensure we completed migrations and deployments in line with best practices.” The IT team at Forex Forest engaged with (ProServe) to design its AWS Landing Zones to reflect best practices. The ProServe team followed principles in the AWS Well Architected Framework , fulfilling industry and regional security standards.

data_flow: Data is stored in Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift and processed by Amazon SageMaker.
business_outcome: By migrating to AWS, the company has overcome the challenges of cost-effectively scaling its legacy on-premises infrastructure, empowering the business to meet the growing market for its services. Moving forward, Forex Forest aims to offer automated trading education globally, leveraging its AWS Global Infrastructure to meet compliance regulations in various regions.

The ProServe team helped Forex Forest migrate its virtual private servers (VPSs) for automated trading to Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) Auto Scaling instances.
The business is building a data lake, with Amazon Redshift as its data warehouse and Amazon Athena , a serverless service, to query data.
Moving forward, Forex Forest aims to offer automated trading education globally, leveraging its AWS Global Infrastructure to meet compliance regulations in various regions.
In addition, students are gaining a greater user experience, completing trades 24/7 with low latency using their VPSs running on AWS.
